newsitem.title: UK: UK engineering pay awards drop to 2-yr low -survey.
newsitem.headline: UK engineering pay awards drop to 2-yr low -survey.

text.p: British engineering industry pay settlements have fallen to their lowest level in two years, the Engineering Employers' Federation said on Monday.
The average engineering pay deal for the three months to February was 3.08 percent, the lowest since the same period in February 1995.
The EEF analysed 407 pay settlements covering 51,090 employees.

"January is traditionally the most popular month for engineering pay settlements, which makes it an important indicator of trends in the industry," said David Yeandle, head of employment affairs at the EEF.
"The lower figures for this January show that employers and employees are maintaining their sensible attitude towards settlements in a time of political and economic uncertainty."
The EEF said pay rises in January averaged 3.05 percent, falling to 2.8 percent in Febuary.
